payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning' (seasons, venues and costs guide), which services.md treats like 'comparing': the primary is the Wedded Concierge consultation (/wonderland-concierge, live in link-map), CTA block text in the services.md default wording 'Speak with a Wedded Advisor' (5 words, no exclamation mark), subtext from brand-facts answering the cost worry the sceptic and funding_parent raised. The CTAs already in place work: all four links carry the correct UTMs, each utm_content (primary, secondary, magnet, closing) appears exactly once, there is one <!-- CTA: primary --> marker, and the panel kept 'calm CTAs placed after the evidence'. Reading order is primary, magnet, secondary, closing. Only one copy change: the secondary lead-in, so it does not imply legal paperwork help. Panel cta_reactions were 'maybe' (4) and 'no' (search_visitor); what readers wanted before clicking (a real person calling first, commission and fee model, real Crete weddings, transfers, who is on the ground, work for non-Australians, scale) is all deferred business detail per brand-facts and the panel's conflicts_resolved, so no copy is added for it. 'Quotes in AUD' stays at its two existing places (primary sentence and close), nothing new added. No Wedded Privileges, prices, transfer arrangements, church or religious paperwork, business details or 'last dance'. A Crete or Greece issue of the digital magazine, or a printable version of the ten venue questions, would be a better-matched magnet; neither exists in link-map, so both are backlog suggestions only.
